roles.name: Ape
roles.ability: You're a walking, talking ape! You can jump 30 feet in the air with no effort. Also, when you throw things, you do an extra point of damage!

roles.name: Cat
roles.ability: Agile and sneaky though you are, your main power is your nine lives! Roll a die; that's how many lives you have left. When you would normally be Knocked Out, instead you remain at 1 Health.

roles.name: Crow
roles.ability: You can fly. That's good, isn't it? It doesn't have to be a crow; you can pick a different bird if you want.

roles.name: Dog
roles.ability: A loyal companion, if there's something to smell you can always smell it. Also, sometimes you smell.

roles.name: Kangaroo
roles.ability: Kangaroos pack one heck of a punch! Your punch does an extra point of damage. Most people try to ignore the boxing gloves.

roles.name: Turtle
roles.ability: A hero in a half shell, you reduce all damage done to you by 1 point.

roles.name: Alien
roles.ability: You have psychic powers! You have a Power stat, although you don't get extra points to distribute.

roles.name: Dwarf
roles.ability: Grumpy, and with a Scottish accent (if you want), you can appraise the value of things with a single glance.

roles.name: Elf
roles.ability: You're very sneaky, and when in natural surroundings, you can be effectively invisible.

roles.name: Ghost
roles.ability: You don't take damage unless it's from a holy source or some special sci-fi ecto-gadget. But you also can't pick things up. So there's that.

roles.name: Goblin
roles.ability: Vicious little scrapper, you can snatch small items from your opponent instead of attacking.

roles.name: Golem
roles.ability: You may be slow (you always go last in the turn) but you also take half damage (round up) because you're, like, made of stone or metal or something.

roles.name: Hobbit
roles.ability: You're a brave little hobbit. Hobbits have tremendous reserves of courage, so you might be scared, but you are never affected by fear.

roles.name: Monster
roles.ability: Grrr! I'm a monster! You're very scary. If you make a Style check against somebody's Style, they have to run away for a minute. You can only do it to them once though.

roles.name: Ogre
roles.ability: Big, scary ogre. If you don't put loads of points into your Brawn Stat you're going wrong somewhere. Anyway, you get an extra +1 to your Brawn Stat, and an extra +2 Health.

roles.name: Robot
roles.ability: I AM A ROBOT! You're basically immune to fear and mental stuff. Cuz you're a robot.

roles.name: Vampire
roles.ability: Creature of the night! When you make an unarmed melee attack, you gain 1 Health as you suck your victim's blood. But you can't go out in the sunlight.

roles.name: Werewolf
roles.ability: You take double damage from silver weapons, but you do get to turn into a wolf at night. You have the same stats, but you're a wolf.

roles.name: Alchemist
roles.ability: You know potions and stuff. You can spend an hour to make a potion that cures any ailment, curse, or disease.

roles.name: Assassin
roles.ability: You're so good at killing people. You do double damage on your first attack against somebody.

roles.name: Barbarian
roles.ability: In tune with nature and good at smashing stuff. When outdoors, in a natural environment add 1 to all your damage scores.

roles.name: Cleric
roles.ability: You can turn the undead. Make a Style check vs. their Defence. If you succeed they can't come within 10 feet of you for an hour.

roles.name: Druid
roles.ability: You can speak to animals. That doesn't make them suddenly intelligent, though.

roles.name: Knight
roles.ability: Chivalry is your middle name. You can take damage for an adjacent ally.

roles.name: Ninja
roles.ability: You can turn invisible for a minute once a day.

roles.name: Outlaw
roles.ability: You're wanted by the law! Wait, that's not a useful ability. But you do have a free hideout where you can't be found.

roles.name: Pirate
roles.ability: Scourge of the Seven Seas! Aaar matey! You have either a hook hand (+1 unarmed damage) or a parrot. Or both, if you like.

roles.name: Ranger
roles.ability: You are amazing at tracking things. In outdoor environments you can stay on the trail of another person or creature as long as you are no more than a day behind.

roles.name: Samurai
roles.ability: You can spend a Karma point to use your Ki! When you do that, your attack with your deadly katana does double damage.

roles.name: Slayer
roles.ability: What do you slay? Vampires? Probably. You do double damage to the thing you slay. No, you can't choose humans.

roles.name: Wizard
roles.ability: You can do magic! You have a Power stat, although you don't get extra points to distribute.

roles.name: Actor
roles.ability: Star of stage and screen, you are great at pretending to be somebody else. Your disguises always work.

roles.name: Archaeologist
roles.ability: You've raided tombs and lost arks. If there's a trap, you can spend a Karma point to circumvent it.

roles.name: Astronaut
roles.ability: All that time in zero-g means you just don't get sick any more. You're immune to the feeling of nausea.

roles.name: Athlete
roles.ability: You can move twice as far in your turn. Normally you can move 10 feet per point of Moves, but you're an Athlete — you can move 20 feet per point of Moves!

roles.name: Bounty Hunter
roles.ability: You can spend a day, and at the end of it determine the location of any individual person or creature. Catching them might be another matter!

roles.name: Boxer
roles.ability: With a quick One-Two, and swift K.O., you really know how to punch. Your unarmed damage increases by 1. And also, once per day, when you would normally be Knocked Out, you can choose to remain on 1 Health.

roles.name: Burglar
roles.ability: Sneaky does it! Up that wall, through the window, crack the safe! Locks mean nothing to you.

roles.name: Chef
roles.ability: You can cook up an amazing meal in an hour, which gives everybody 1 Health back. Plus you do +1 damage with knives.

roles.name: Con Artist
roles.ability: Liar, liar, pants on fire! You have a collection of very convincing fake IDs, and can pull out any one you need at a moment's notice.

roles.name: Cowboy
roles.ability: Yeehaw! Fastest gun in the West! When deciding who gets to go first, you get a quick shot in before it all kicks off.

roles.name: Detective
roles.ability: Are there any clues? If there are, you spot them automatically. You don't even have to roll any dice!

roles.name: Doctor
roles.ability: Medic! You can heal people. For every Karma point you spend, you heal somebody (or yourself) one point of damage. This takes you a minute, but you can spend as much Karma as you like.

roles.name: Engineer
roles.ability: If something is broken, you can fix it within an hour. Well, within reason. Not like the Golden Gate Bridge or something, but a vending machine or a car.

roles.name: Gambler
roles.ability: You rely on luck. Any time when there's equal chances of something, you can spend a Karma point and it works out in your favor.

roles.name: Gangster
roles.ability: You know how to make someone an offer they can't refuse. You gain the Intimidation Focus for free, in addition to whatever other Focus you choose for your Brawn Stat.

roles.name: Hacker
roles.ability: Breaking into computer systems is what you do. You can circumvent computer security. It usually takes you about an hour.

roles.name: Hermit
roles.ability: You live alone. People aren't much use to you. When you're acting alone, without allies, you get an extra die.

roles.name: Inventor
roles.ability: A gadget for every occasion. You can spend a Karma point to pull out a gadget which helps you with your next dice roll. You have to describe the gadget. Basically, you get double value from Karma points - two extra dice instead of one.

roles.name: Musician
roles.ability: Sing me a song, oh music man! You can make music, and everyone who can hear it is affected. Roll your Style Stat vs. their Smarts Stat, or they are basically dazed for a minute. Unless you do something to snap them out of it like hit them or make a loud noise. After the minute they can't be affected again.

roles.name: Pilot
roles.ability: You know how to fly planes. Or spaceships.

roles.name: Priest
roles.ability: The undead cannot harm you. They're still pretty scary, though.

roles.name: Professor
roles.ability: You know stuff. You get free Focuses in History, Languages, and Theology.

roles.name: Reporter
roles.ability: Nothing can keep you from that scoop! You know how to ask the right question. Once per day, you can ask an Extra a question. You get the answer if they know it. Just the one question, mind, so choose wisely!

roles.name: Scientist
roles.ability: If a monster has a weakness, you know it automatically. It's just a question of physics.

roles.name: Smuggler
roles.ability: You're pretty good at hiding things. If you have something hidden about your person, or in your vehicle, or your spaceship, or your… well, you get the idea. Anyway, they won't find it.

roles.name: Soldier
roles.ability: You are great at tactics. When deciding who goes first, it's you.

roles.name: Spy
roles.ability: You know how to make the bad guy give you a monologue explaining their whole plan. Weirdly, time kinda freezes while they do it. Then they laugh manically, or something.

roles.name: Student
roles.ability: Funny how heroes often seem to be high school kids! You have homework, and the principal is on your back. But you can pretty much get away with stuff because you're a kid. People just overlook you. More fool them!

roles.name: Stuntman
roles.ability: You never seem to get injured. You take damage, but you always manage to get up again — you recover ALL your Health every day.

roles.name: Speedster
roles.ability: You go fast. Real fast. Each turn you get two actions instead of one.

roles.name: Vigilante
roles.ability: The criminals are all afraid of you, and rightly so. Once per day you can make a Style roll vs. a criminal's Smarts, and if you win they basically surrender and beg you not to hurt them. If you lose, they laugh and probably try to kill you, and you can't use this ability against them ever again.

focuses.name: Medicine
focuses.note: Patients under your care recover 2 Health per day instead of 1.

focuses.name: Shooting
focuses.note: Shooting covers any ranged combat, even throwing items.

focuses.name: Wealth
focuses.note: Adds its dice to Style rolls to buy gear.

focuses.name: Brawling
focuses.note: Brawling covers any melee combat, armed or not.

gear.name: Communicator
gear.description: Think a smartphone, but without any apps. But it can reach space.

gear.name: Grapple Gun
gear.description: With one action, ascend 30' up to a location you can stand.

gear.name: Healing Potion
gear.description: This adds +1 Health.

gear.name: Weapon
gear.description: Sword, pistol, rifle, etc. See the weapon damage table.

gear.name: Horse
gear.description: While on it you have Moves 8.

gear.name: Magic Armor
gear.description: You get +2 Defence.

gear.name: Magic Sword
gear.description: It does +1 damage.

gear.name: Protective Amulet
gear.description: This protects you completely once from one instance of harm. Then it's useless to you, although somebody else can use it.

gear.name: "Spirit Stopper" Anti-Plasm Particle Thrower
gear.description: Does 2 damage, and can affect ghosts. Makes a hell of a mess, though.

gear.name: Thermal Detonator
gear.description: Bomb which does 3 damage to everybody within 30 feet. Also see Holy Hand Grenade.

gear.name: Tricorder
gear.description: Grants +1d6 to all Science rolls.

gear.name: Wand
gear.description: Gives you an extra die on Power rolls.

gear.name: X-Ray Glasses
gear.description: They do what they say. Can't see through lead, because that's what it says in Superman.

gear.name: Invisibility Cloak
gear.description: Or ring. Could be either. The latter might be evil. Elves probably make the former.

gear.name: Staff of Power
gear.description: The top lights up a 30 foot radius. And it gives you 3 extra Karma points which you can use to cast spells only.

gear.name: Talking Car
gear.description: It obeys your commands and drives itself. Can be a bit sarcastic at times.

gear.name: Holy Grail
gear.description: No, you can't have that.

gear.name: Flying Carpet
gear.description: It flies and you can ride it. It might be a broomstick. Or a jetpack. Or even some winged sandals.

gear.name: Bazooka
gear.description: Ranged weapon. 5 damage.

gear.name: Bow
gear.description: Ranged weapon. 2 damage.

gear.name: Club
gear.description: Melee weapon. 2 damage.

gear.name: Grenade
gear.description: Thrown weapon. 4 damage.

gear.name: Knife
gear.description: Melee weapon. 2 damage.

gear.name: Machine Gun
gear.description: Ranged weapon. 4 damage.

gear.name: Pistol
gear.description: Ranged weapon. 3 damage. Might be a regular ballistic weapon or a laser pistol.

gear.name: Rifle
gear.description: Ranged weapon. 3 damage.

gear.name: Spear
gear.description: Melee or thrown weapon. 2 damage.

gear.name: Sword
gear.description: Melee weapon. 3 damage. Might be steel or a laser sword.

extras.name: Mook
notes: Add any Focus in one Stat (rolls four dice when using it).
extras.description: Represents most civilians, workers, and peasants — fantasy, modern and sci-fi — who don't have a starring role (or often even a name) in your adventure.

attacks.name: Lashing vines
attacks.note: 15-foot range, grabs target requiring a melee attack to escape

attacks.name: Sticky Web
attacks.note: 30-foot range, restrains target, needs Brawn 10 check to escape

extras.name: Necromancer
notes: Use an action to summon one zombie within 30 feet. Can have up to three zombies at one time.

extras.name: Ninja
notes: Turn invisible for up to one minute.

extras.name: Vampire
notes: Can turn into a bat or a wolf.

extras.name: Wolf
notes: When attacking in a group of 4 or more wolves, each gains +1 die to attacks.

extras.name: Zombie
notes: Victim becomes a zombie if reduced to 0 Health.
